snippet.title: GuGu Pizza Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: May 2025
snippet.description:
GuGu Pizza’s motto is to deliver anywhere! So couldn't refuse the pineapple pizza order that came from the space station. Eventually, the pigeon deliveryman begins a high-altitude jump to deliver pizza to space, passing through the city, forest, and sky...

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308560/GuGu_Pizza__Delivering_Pizza_to_the_Space_Station_Boss_this_is_just_not_right/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.
